ITEM 1 | Dark red to burgundy oval pieces, about 2 cm long and 1.8 cm wide, with smooth, glossy, taut skins and some lighter red highlights. About 16 pieces are loosely piled in a cluster in the lower-middle of a white bowl about 15 cm across, covering roughly half of its surface. Firm, juicy-looking, no cut surfaces, no cooking signs. | 80

ITEM 2 | One pale yellow-green oval piece, about 2 cm long, with a smooth, slightly translucent glossy skin. It sits at the top edge of the cluster in the white bowl, touching the red pieces. Firm, whole, uncut. | 4
